intent.caption: Premium pricing card — A single flagship pricing card: tier name, price figure, feature list rhythm, one accent CTA row.

visualSpec.effects: Card plane 2.4w x 3.2h scene units, corner radius 0.06, albedo #16161d over background #0b0b10 with a 0.006-unit hairline border #2a2a33; machined header strip 2.4w x 0.08h across the top edge with brushed anisotropy 0.6, roughness 0.55, metalness 0.5, clearcoat 0.2; interior padding 0.5 (2x base unit); vertical rhythm top-down: tier name, price figure with per-month caption on its baseline, 0.5-unit gap, then four feature rows each 0.375h (1.5x base) separated by 0.006-unit hairlines #23232b; CTA row 1.4w x 0.36h anchored 0.5 units above the bottom edge, engineered vertical gradient #ff4450 (at 0.0) -> #c1121f (at 1.0), ink label, perimeter emissive #ff2a38 at intensity 1.5; card mount weighted-settle scale 1.04 -> 1.0 over 900ms cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1); feature rows stagger fade-up opacity 0 -> 1 and y +0.2 -> 0 over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) at 80ms stagger; CTA press scale 1.0 -> 0.97 over 120ms cubic-bezier(0.175,0.885,0.32,1.275); the upper-left key light drags a specular band across the header strip during the settle so the card reads machined, not printed.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Card settles with 1.04 overshoot, feature rows cascade in at 80ms stagger, CTA compresses on press.
sceneSpec.contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 features and price on surface; 4.8:1 ink CTA label on accent
